extracted.intended_audience: journalists, newsroom staff, and news organizations seeking training, tools, and best-practice guidance for digital journalism, audience growth, and revenue
extracted.subtask_description: A resource hub providing lessons, courses, products, and case studies to help news organizations develop audiences, strengthen digital journalism, verify content, adopt ML tools, and grow revenue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop your audience
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explore audience resources and courses to understand and grow your audience; e.g., 'Start building your audience' course teaches understanding and growth using analytics, surveys, and tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Keep visitors engaged with recirculation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage and retain visitors by using article recirculation, videos, and Core Web Vitals (explicitly recommended in the 'Keep visitors engaged' course).

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify photos using reverse image search
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use reverse image search as a verification technique for photos (listed as a lesson under 'Strengthen digital journalism').

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthen digital journalism skills with Google tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Strengthen your digital skills by learning advanced techniques on familiar tools like Google Search, Google Maps and Google Trends.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Take foundational courses (e.g., 'Fundamentals') to build advanced skills using Google Search, Maps, Trends and other familiar tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learn and apply machine learning in reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction to Machine Learning; Hands-on Machine Learning
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Courses provide insight on how journalists use machine learning in newsrooms and teach practical skills such as training ML models to identify and classify images.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build a fundraising strategy / grow revenue
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources and lessons aim to help news organizations grow revenue, including building fundraising strategies and other revenue resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase site traffic via search, newsletters, social, and ads
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Search, newsletters, social sharing, and ads to attract more visits (explicit guidance from the 'Increase site traffic' course).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use data-driven product insights to inform site improvements
rubrics_metrics.description: News Consumer Insights: Get data-driven recommendations for your site
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage products that provide data-driven recommendations (e.g., News Consumer Insights) to guide site and audience decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use document-analysis tools to process large corpora
rubrics_metrics.description: Pinpoint: Upload and analyze large numbers of documents with the power of Google Search, AI, and machine learning.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt tools (e.g., Pinpoint) that allow uploading and analyzing many documents using search, AI, and ML to support reporting workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize reach and impact to ensure access to reliable information
rubrics_metrics.description: Reach and impact: work with governments, community leaders and other companies to make sure that everyone can access reliable information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage with stakeholders and partners to expand reach and impact; emphasize accessibility and reliability of information as a core objective.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learn from case studies showcasing practical newsroom initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Case Studies — See how news organizations around the world are growing their news coverage and digital businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Study examples such as fact-checking networks (CekFakta.com), open data and civic participation projects, audience engagement experiments, safe-space coaching for underrepresented journalists, bringing underreported stories to attention, and equity advocacy to derive actionable best practices.
